visualCharacteristics.purpose: Row of benefit items with a small icon beside a title and one line of text
visualCharacteristics.summary: Small icon left of title + one line, laid out in one row
visualCharacteristics.layout: Icon left of the text; 2 columns on mobile, all items in one row from 900px

contentPattern.structure: cell 1: icon or small image; cell 2: title (bold or heading) and a short line; an optional link makes the whole item clickable
contentPattern.source: 4 look-alike benefit items: icon + title + short line (10% OFF, Earn Neu Coins, No Cost EMI, Snapmint)

usage: Sign-up benefits, USPs and feature lists with small icons.
reuseGuidance: Use for icon + text side by side. For an icon stacked above a label use cards-icon-stack.
